name: Taira no Tokuko
source:
Daughter of Taira no Kiyomori, sister of Tomomori and Shigehira.
Of all his children, Kiyomori doted on her the most.
She joined Emperor Takakura and gave birth to the heir to the throne, thereby consolidating the Heike clan's position.
She is free-spirited and moody.
